fb_text:
The email every owner dreads: "Your guy never came Tuesday — why am I being billed?"

That used to mean an argument. He said, she said, and me stuck in the middle hoping the client takes my word for it.

Now my techs send a quick voice note from each stop. FieldNotes turns it into a timestamped service log — and drafts a client-safe recap I can send with one tap.

So when that email comes in, I don't argue. I hit send on the recap. Visit date, time, what was done — straight from my own crew's notes.

Recap sent. Invoice paid. Argument over.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — and disputes like this are exactly why I built FieldNotes for my own crew first.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
